task: Pirmais gatis uzdevums — define yourself (who you are, your role, what tools/limits you have), propose 3 quick high-value tasks you are best at for EWART WOODS within a 100 EUR/week budget, and confirm you will use the outbox protocol. Read exchange/gatis/context.md first.

Nogādā e-pastu: izlasi exchange/gatis/email-to-ance.txt un NOSŪTI to uz ance.ewartwoods@gmail.com (no ewartwoods@gmail.com vai sava e-pasta kanāla). Pēc izsūtīšanas ieraksti outbox (status done) ar message-id/sūtīšanas laiku. Ja nevar nosūtīt — report blocked ar kļūdu, nevis minē. Vaidzaba e-pasta pieejas atslēga? Izmanto GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD no ~/ewart-woods-farm/.env (ja tur ir) vai savu esošo e-pasta pieeju.
